what_happened.line: The Finance Committee set its fall schedule: meetings on September 26 and October 3, and a public hearing on the special Town Meeting warrant on October 10.
The committee discussed year goals: defining level service and level funded budgets, a framework for evaluating new positions, and a list of outside funding sources.
The town manager previewed special Town Meeting articles, including a land purchase partly reimbursed by two grants and likely funded by borrowing.
A placeholder article would fund the first year of a police contract by transfer from the salary reserve account.
The committee took no budget votes and approved its minutes as amended before adjourning.

why_it_matters: The land purchase article would authorize borrowing, so residents at the special Town Meeting will be asked to vote on a debt that is meant to be reduced by grant reimbursement and a later rescission.
The goals on level services and new positions set the terms the committee will use to judge department budget requests that affect future tax bills.
watch_next: The October 10 public hearing on the special Town Meeting warrant.
The chair's circulated list of committee goals, and the October 24 meeting for any remaining Town Meeting business.
